summary.scope: Owned Windows process, same binary/kernel/data/thread count. Scheduler-selected vs topology-derived placement only during prefill, full transition costs timed. Shared observers outside clocks. Screening only, not HF/mx or production readiness.

plan.scope: Real-model scratch prefill-only placement, unchanged kernels. Full candidate Session setup/apply/verify/restore inside pp clock. Shared unbound observer verifies masks between phases outside clocks in both arms. No external HF/mx floor claim. Candidate snapshot serialization and object destruction are conservatively included in pp time.
plan.order: Pairs -1..4. Odd pairs including -1: models8b then0.6b, arms prefill then scheduler. Even pairs: models0.6b then8b, arms scheduler thenprefill. One internal warmup then measured iteration per process; retain all24 invocations and48 internal records.
plan.mapping: Query single-group physical core masks and child allowed process mask, sort by lowest allowed LP and pick first6 distinct cores. Include caller0. Abort unsupported topology. No post-result map search.
plan.timing_boundary: Fresh per-iteration candidate Session construction, topology, apply, verification, model.prefill and checked restore, candidate report serialization and Session destruction inside pp clock. Scheduler times actual prefill only. Shared unbound observer setup before pp, mask/CPU verification plus snapshot after pp before tg, and verification after tg are outside clocks in both arms. plan.advance_rule: Both models require >=5% higher prefill mean AND median tok/s, with at least4/5 strict paired prefill wins. Both models decode mean AND median tok/s must be no worse than0.5% below scheduler. All conditions required; otherwise stop this prefill-only mapping candidate. No sample removal or pooling with prior session.
plan.prerequisites: Placement correctness, exception restoration, independent source/harness review pass; all builds/checks terminal; verified immutable sources/binary/inputs and empty process guards; no concurrent timing/model/build work.
plan.limits: Final-position self-consistency only, not HF or full-context proof. Restored masks do not reset placement/cache/boost behavior. Shared untimed observer dispatch between phases can affect subsequent scheduling; this is a diagnostic comparison, not the final mx floor harness. Six identical phase thread counts only; no pool recreation lifecycle is tested by model run.
